[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The marriage index names John Eldeit Glasgow and Mary Ann Lusted, married in 1860. Registration place: Camden, New South Wales, Australia.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1780/records/1764828 Ancestry, Australia, Marriage Index, 1788–1950: John Eldeit Glasgow, record 1780/1764828].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9776/records/329570 Ancestry, Australia, Births and Baptisms, 1792–1981: John Eldit Glasgow, record 9776/329570].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The marriage and baptism indexes give Eldeit and Eldit as spellings of his middle name. The matching spouse name supports a probable household link.

[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The birth index names George E Glasgow, born 1861 in New South Wales. It gives parents John E Glasgow and Mary A Glasgow, registration place Tabulam, New South Wales, Australia, and registration number 12555.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568697 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: George E Glasgow, record 1778/2568697].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9776/records/329569 Ancestry, Australia, Births and Baptisms, 1792–1981: George Edward Glasgow, record 9776/329569].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The birth index gives Tabulam as the registration district. The baptism index gives Casino as birthplace and the Clarence River district as the baptism place. The matching initials and parents support a probable match.

Additional identity review: The birth index names John E or John Eldeit Glasgow and Mary A or Mary Ann Glasgow in New South Wales. The 1860 Camden marriage of John Eldeit Glasgow and Mary Ann Lusted identifies the parents’ marriage; the shared names, districts and chronology support the family. The parent links are probable, not proved by a single record.
